notes.title: Prologue version major update 1.0.1.4
notes.notes:
Bug fixes
[olist]
Fix the problem of the archive button getting stuck after multiple clicks
Improve the performance of the game at night
[/olist]
New content added 
[olist]
Keys can be used directly without having to operate from the backpack
The E button can be used to determine directly to facilitate the player's operation
Add the way down from the men's room on the 2nd floor If you don't want to have more contact with the barman Xiao Yuan can try
Add dormitory plot Now you can choose to escape from the dormitory (screwdriver is very important)
Add news desk
[/olist]

notes.title: 1.0.0.8b version
notes.notes:
I found the problem of reading the archive, because of an encryption program caused by the release of the last encrypted version, the archive and then read the archive problem, the past archive can not be used, a million apologies. To express my apologies, all players who played for free before June 10, screenshot contact my email, I will, at the time of the release of the official version, give a magical prop.
I'm really sorry for the bad experience I've had with the game for the first time and the bugs. But as long as you contact me, I will find a way to help you solve the problem. I also hope you give a positive feedback, thank you!
The next update will be updated on the player run

Fix the bug that 403 walls can be passed through
Fix the bug that the night archive reads the file (previous archives are recommended not to use)
Fix the dormitory building toilets appear, search the emergence of the bug (test fix)
